{{nihongo|'''hikida Shrine'''|調田坐一事尼古神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Tsukudanimasu Hitokotoneko Shrine''' (つくだにますひとことねこじんじゃ) is a shrine in {{ill|Katsuragi, Nara|ar|كاتسوراغي (نارا)|azb|کاتسوراقی، نارا|ca|Katsuragi (Nara)|ce|Кацураги (гӀала)|ceb|Katsuragi (lungsod sa Hapon)|de|Katsuragi|eo|Kacuragi (Nara)|es|Katsuragi (Nara)|fa|کاتسوراگی، نارا|fi|Katsuragi (Nara)|fr|Katsuragi|gl|Katsuragi, Nara|hy|Կացուրագի|id|Katsuragi, Nara|it|Katsuragi (Nara)|ja|葛城市|ko|가쓰라기시|mzn|کاتسوراگی، نارا|nl|Katsuragi (Nara)|pl|Katsuragi (Nara)|pt|Katsuragi (Nara)|ro|Katsuragi, Nara|ru|Кацураги (город)|sv|Katsuragi|tg|Катсураги|tl|Katsuragi, Nara|tr|Katsuragi|tt|Кацураги (шәһәр)|uk|Кацураґі (Нара)|ur|کاٹسوراگی، نارا|vi|Katsuragi, Nara|war|Katsuragi, Nara|zh|葛城市|zh_classical|葛城市|zh_min_nan|Katuragi-chhī|zh_yue|葛城|qid=Q659672}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. Also called '''Hikida Shrine''' (ひきだじんじゃ). It is a {{ill|Shikinai Taisha|ja|式内大社|simple|Shikinai Taisha|qid=Q134917288}}, and its former rank was village shrine.

=== History ===
=== Outline ===
The founding period is unknown. In the ''{{ill|Shinshō Kyakuchokufushō|ja|新抄格勅符抄|qid=Q11502312}}'', a deity thought to be this shrine (“Tsukita-no-Kami”) is recorded as having received two shrine households: one from {{ill|Harima Province|Q1047523|qid=Q1047523|lt=Harimanokuni}} in {{ill|770|Q25021|qid=Q25021}} ({{ill|Jingo-keiun|Q1373049|qid=Q1373049}} 4), and one from {{ill|Yamato Province|Q907495|qid=Q907495}} in {{ill|806|Q30021|qid=Q30021}} ({{ill|Daidō|Q1373191|qid=Q1373191}} 1). In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}, it is listed as “Yamato Province, Katsushimo District, Tsukudanimasu Hitokotoneko Shrine, Great, Tsukinami and Niiname,” and ranked as a great shrine.

=== Court rank ===
* {{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611|lt=Ten'an}} 3 ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}), {{ill|January 27|Q2284|qid=Q2284}}: promoted from Junior Fifth Lower to Junior Fifth Upper (''{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}}'') - written as “Tsukuda Hitokotoneko-no-Kami.”

=== Enshrined deities ===
The deities are Hitokotoneko Ōkami and Kotoshironushi Ōkami. Hitokotoneko Ōkami is treated as the same deity as {{ill|Hitokotonushi|Q10864079|qid=Q10864079}}, and “Neko” is interpreted as a title for a noble male deity.

=== Subsidiary shrines ===
*Toyo'uke Shrine
*Kasuga Shrine
